lane: L6 one decision (lab H40, 2026-10-07; the user's order of 5 new Shorts, 2 of 5): an either/or the viewer answers in the first seconds (2-second countdown), then the answer with one memory line; typed phrase 'confusing english words' / 'affect or effect'

beats.speech: Affect or effect? Which one is the verb?

card.headline: Affect
card.sub: usually the verb. Rain affects my mood.

beats.speech: Affect: usually the verb. Rain affects my mood.

card.headline: Effect
card.sub: usually the noun. Rain has an effect on my mood.

beats.speech: Effect: usually the noun. Rain has an effect on my mood.

card.headline: Remember
card.sub: Affect is the action. Effect is the end result.

beats.speech: Remember: affect is the action. Effect is the end result.
